items.title: Albert Glenny Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: They had one of my friends at the camp out there, Lucian.

ctx.x: The lawn party was right outdoors. You eat red beans? Oh, yeah.

I can cook them too. Yeah, I don't eat them. I don't eat no kind of beans. No? No. Well, I'll tell you. Used to get a dollar and a half, a dollar and sixty-two dollars, a dime two and a half, a man, you know. It's coming with the people you play for. It was the people you play for. It was the people you play for. It was the people you play for. It was good time. That's called it. They had one of my friends at the camp out there, Lucian. Lucian, what's his name again? What? What? Where's that camp out there? Camp…
